purpose: Execute the next safe nonduplicate evaluator-only gate from the two-axis Trigger-2 research delta: prove at source/evaluator-design scope that answerability subtype can change while candidate-correctness remains unscorable, and candidate correctness can change while answerability remains answerable.

external_method_evidence.claim: AbstentionBench motivates treating abstention as an independent reliability axis; its evaluated reasoning fine-tuning settings degraded abstention on average.
Recent temporal-QA abstention work reports that SFT can induce overconfidence and that abstention remains a distinct optimization target even when reasoning improves.

Structural abstention formalizes a trusted-kernel/generative-shell separation where generative components do not mint fact values; this is methodologically consistent with EntityOS deterministic authority boundaries.
Variable-binding research shows transformers can pass through shortcut/heuristic phases before systematic binding, supporting minimal-pair and family-disjoint evaluator design.

factorization.authority_boundary: Gold labels are evaluator/source semantics only. S0 truth, stale/current/rebase validity, capability and real effects remain deterministic EntityOS boundaries.

rules: ANSWERABLE_FROM_CURRENT_EVIDENCE cannot be UNSCORABLE in this seed

supported_at_source_scope: The proposed label space is mechanically separable: 8 minimal-pair families change answerability subtype while keeping candidate correctness UNSCORABLE.
Four minimal-pair families flip candidate correctness while answerability remains ANSWERABLE.
Authority-origin pairs demonstrate that the same candidate string is answerable when bound to current S0 evidence and unanswerable when supported only by simulation.
Rebase pairs force runtime-proven REBASE_PROVEN to differ from model/caller text asserting rebase.
not_supported: No claim that Qwen3.5-0.8B internally represents these axes separately.
No claim that this seed improves model behavior.
No physical GRID10, HCU, EntityOS runtime or training credit.
research_return.hypothesis: A two-axis evaluator can expose failure modes hidden by aggregate confidence/refusal metrics and can distinguish epistemic abstention from broad refusal suppression.
research_return.counterhypothesis: The factorization may be evaluator-convenient but add no predictive/generalization value over a simpler single-axis policy when tested on the selected checkpoint.
research_return.next_discriminator: After current P0 checkpoint-input-identity execution is separately authorized and passes, run the same frozen minimal-pair evaluator across ABI-eligible BASE/POSTTRAINED/TARGET_MEASURED candidates under identical greedy renderer/input identity. Promote the factorization only if it provides nonredundant error discrimination without increasing allowed-task refusal.

current_p0_unchanged.note: This evaluator source delta does not bypass or replace Trigger-2 ledger V48 P0.
